rationale: All 11 acceptance criteria (7 story-AC + 4 plan decisions) pass per the acceptance lens, and the edge-case lens found zero unguarded reachable paths. findings.title: Premium rows lose default truncation tooltip
findings.problem: DefaultModelOptionRow (used via itemTemplate for both dropdowns) renders the label with only a CSS `truncate` class. The Select component it replaces (DefaultOptionTemplate) used `useIsTruncated` to show the full label in a tooltip whenever the text was clipped. That recovery mechanism is lost for every row in these two dropdowns now that itemTemplate is supplied.
findings.impact: A long model label (e.g. 'Bedrock Claude Opus 4.5', or longer premium model names) that overflows the row width is silently clipped with no way for the user to read the full name — a regression specifically affecting the premium models this ticket is about surfacing clearly.
findings.recommendation: Mirror LlmOptionRow's pattern in src/pages/assistants/components/AssistantForm/components/LLMSelector.tsx: add a label ref + useIsTruncated(labelRef), and set data-tooltip-id/data-tooltip-content on the row (or label span) when truncated, matching the project's established truncation-tooltip convention.
